Introduction

Enami Asa is a Japanese rapper, singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under YG Entertainment. She is best known as the main rapper and main dancer of the girl group BABYMONSTER. She made her official debut on November 27, 2023 with the group's digital single "Batter Up".
